title: Filecoin Open Grants
description: Open grants of up to $50,000 for ideas that advance the Filecoin ecosystem, bring significant new usage, or directly advance the Filecoin mission. Proposals are GitHub issues in the filecoin-project/devgrants repo, reviewed continuously and paid by milestone under an open source grant agreement.
reward: Up to $50,000 per open grant, paid by milestone

eligibility.note: work that enhances the Filecoin network; IPFS-only or libp2p-only work is de-emphasized

ideas: A Filecoin integration for a popular developer tool
A data preparation and onboarding CLI
Retrieval tooling that speeds up data access
setup: sign in to GitHub to open the proposal issue
each_time: a milestone table with dates and funding
rules: Proposals are reviewed continuously. A preliminary review update comes within about two weeks, and a final decision generally within four weeks of submission.
Categories: developer and data tooling, integrations, research and protocols, storage, retrieval, and FVM.
Funding that improves the Filecoin network is prioritized; projects only about IPFS, libp2p or other stacks are de-emphasized.
Accepted teams sign an Open Source Software Grant Agreement with the work plan and funding milestones. No work should begin until both parties sign.
The agreement and all payments must be with the same party, either the individual or the organization.
The form asks you to agree to open source the work under the MIT/Apache-2 dual license.
Break the work into 2 to 4 milestones with functionality, people, funding and real dates for each.

submission_requirements.label: Individual or Entity Name
submission_requirements.description: Is the proposal on behalf of an individual, or an entity/organization? The agreement and any payments must be completed by the same party.

submission_requirements.label: (Optional) Filecoin ecosystem affiliations
submission_requirements.description: Disclose existing work relationships with Protocol Labs Network organizations, including Protocol Labs, Filecoin Foundation and Filecoin Foundation for the Decentralized Web.

submission_requirements.label: Do you agree to open source all work you do on behalf of this RFP under the MIT/Apache-2 dual-license?

submission_requirements.label: Impact
submission_requirements.description: Why the proposal is valuable for Filecoin, IPFS or related ecosystems: pain points, benefits, risks, what success looks like. 2 to 3 paragraphs.

submission_requirements.label: Outcomes

submission_requirements.label: Adoption, Reach, and Growth Strategies

submission_requirements.label: Development Roadmap
